Heroes can stand away from their banner during replay animation. Pet House (1,26) identified by green roof, treasure nest, purple banner and feed bowl. Dark Barracks (37,15) identified by white fur/paw-print roof, consistent with its Druid-era appearance. Glowing campfires are Army Camps, not Teslas or traps. Dormant low roofed turret (30,24) is Revenge Tower. The two matching wooden-arm catapults in the core are Scattershots (20,15) and (22,28); the blue/gold weapon on the right flank (26,12) is the third Ricochet Cannon. Walls: digitize.py walls initially returned 660 candidates. After building exclusion, original candidates plus a blue-gray cap pass were checked in labeled crops; false building/UI/hero detections were removed and visible missed rails/posts added manually. Final count is 274. Original detector output and wall-review-decisions.json are preserved. Confidence: medium overall; grid fit and building counts are stronger than obscured pad anchors, hidden walls, Guardian identity and some modes. This is not a verified exact reconstruction. The grayed level-5 final spell has no displayed count and remains unidentified, with Earthquake/Revive alternatives. Raw icon crops and literal counts are retained. Destroyed buildings: No separate, confidently identifiable destroyed-building rubble or pad was found. The outlined square beside the Workshop is treated as part of the Workshop graphic; no second building was invented there.
